claims: Contractors earning above $75,000 per year in gross business turnover must register for GST
whys: Cross-file fix proposed (and checked by a verifier) in the first fact-fix round. Proposal: ATO: register at GST turnover of $75,000 or more (gross income minus GST), not 'above'. Import GST_REGISTRATION_THRESHOLD from @/lib/constants/gig-tax. Same fix at line 231 ('turnover exceeding $75,000' -> 'GST turnover of {formatAUD(GST_REGISTRATION_THRESHOLD)} or more'; 'below $75,000' -> render constant) and line 227 ('above the $75,000 threshold' -> 'at or above the {formatAUD(GST_REGISTRATION_THRESHOLD)} threshold'). Line 231 also lists taxi/rideshare but not limousine or fuel tax credits. After: Contractors with a GST turnover of {formatAUD(GST_REGISTRATION_THRESHOLD)} or more a year must register for GST
